tagline.en: One SIM that works everywhere, pay per MB
tagline.zh: 一张卡走全球，按流量计费

description.en: Drimsim takes a different approach: one physical SIM or eSIM that works in 200+ countries with pure pay-per-MB pricing and no bundled plans. Great for multi-country trips and light users who only need messaging and navigation.
description.zh: Drimsim 走的是另一条路线：一张实体SIM卡或eSIM即可在200+国家使用，纯按流量（MB）计费，无需选择套餐。适合多国行程以及只需即时通讯和导航的轻度用户。

en: Pay only for the data you use
Available as physical SIM and eSIM
